fact: As reported on 14 October 2026, the Banco de Cabo Verde's Aviso n.º 6/2019 of 18 July 2019 remains the rule on authorising payment and e-money institutions, setting minimum capital of 2 million, 5 million or 10 million escudos for payment institutions by service and 20 million for e-money institutions, with no later change found.
title: Capital mínimo trava novas empresas tecnológicas no setor bancário, diz consultor
